name: tracer
description: A quantitative-goal-driven autonomous improvement loop, run as a PM. One command (/tracer) reads durable state and runs one of init / roadmap / advisor-escalation / routine-patrol / completion; it regenerates an HTML dashboard every cycle so a human can intervene. Two-layer reward (per-Issue eval + goal metric), reward-hacking guards, and staged autonomy. Works in any repo (state lives in the target repo's .claude/goals/).
